propositions: The packaged CLI overview help (overview.txt) and ticket-model documentation incorrectly state that unlink takes no optional relation argument, contradicting the shipped relation-scoped unlink implementation in the library and CLI.
Commit 73abb5805f added relation selection to unlink but updated only subcommand help and generated references, omitting the independently maintained overview.txt and ticket-model.md surfaces.

Documentation must preserve and explain the omitted-relation most-recent fallback contract while clarifying that an explicit relation removes only that relation while preserving other active relations on the pair.
The event-schema.md operation description uses stale pre-change wording and must distinguish the optional relation selector from the emitted link-UUID cancellation in the UNLINK event payload.
